items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-05-28
items.q: I wouldn't be a bit surprised he sold a little bit under the table, but then who am I to impugn the family of the president, you know?

ctx.x: So certain people, you know, always had a prescription for scotch. And I wouldn't be a bit surprised he sold a little bit under the table, but then who am I to impugn the family of the president, you know?
The Kennedy's. Were you born at home or in a hospital?
No, in a hospital. In a hospital. Hotel Duke.
